correctness.rationale: Independent all-n check: conditional on the maximum being at most x>0, the n observations are iid from the truncated exponential, so the expected unbiased sample variance is its population variance, lambda^(-2) - x^2 e^(-lambda x)/(1-e^(-lambda x))^2. Integrating the centered sample variance against the survival indicator of the maximum gives the covariance integral of x^2 e^(-lambda x)(1-e^(-lambda x))^(n-2) over x>0. With u=e^(-lambda x), the integral is lambda^(-3) times the second derivative in a of B(a,n-1) at a=1. The product B(a,n-1)=(n-2)!/[a(a+1)...(a+n-2)] yields (H_{n-1}^2+H_{n-1}^{(2)})/(n-1), exactly (1) after restoring the scale. This covers n=2 as well and proves strict positivity. Independent exponential spacings give Var(M_n)=H_n^{(2)}/lambda^2; the unbiased-variance identity with central fourth moment 9/lambda^4 gives (3). The correlation and both asymptotic constants then follow. Decoupling is interpreted as vanishing Pearson correlation, not as a joint-limit assertion. Packaged rational replay was inspected, not needed for the proof.
